name: wordpress-mcp-connector
description: Local WordPress MCP connector with a web management dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Codex plugin companion for the local WordPress MCP connector. Credentials stay in the local encrypted connector store and are not embedded in the plugin manifest. Open the local manager at http://127.0.0.1:8787 to add sites, update credentials, test endpoints, manage permissions, and copy MCP config.
defaultPrompt: Open the WordPress MCP settings dashboard.
List the configured WordPress MCP tools.
